product_name: Oppo Reno15c 5G (Afterglow Pink, 12GB RAM, 256GB Storage) with No Cost EMI/Additional Exchange Offers
description: 【DESIGN & DURABILITY – A Dazzling Masterpiece Built for Adventure】:Reno 15c is a piece of wearable art engineered to endure. It features the Dancing Aurora Design—a truly 3D glass back where light flows like the Northern Lights with every turn. Protected by the highest-rated IP69 All-Weather Armour, it survives everything from hot water jets to 2-meter underwater submersion, while its All-Round Armour architecture with sponge-bionic cushioning ensures superior drop protection on all your journeys. 【DISPLAY & FEEL – An Immersive, Eye-Friendly View in a Sleek Frame】: Experience a buttery-smooth view in a body designed for comfort. The 120Hz Smart Adaptive OLED screen is ultra-smooth, incredibly bright (1400 nits peak), and smartly protects your eyes with 2160Hz PWM dimming. Housed in an ultra-slim and light body under 8.1mm thin, it offers ultimate one-hand comfort. The exclusive Coral Fleece-Like Panel on select colors provides a soft, skin-friendly velvet touch that resists fingerprints. 【PERFORMANCE & LONGEVITY – Flagship Speed That Stays Fast for Years】: Engineered for lasting power, the Reno 15C delivers flagship-level smoothness certified to stay fast and responsive for 72 months. Powered by the efficient 4nm Snapdragon 6 Gen 1 platform and enhanced by AI HyperBoost 2.0, it provides stable, cool performance for gaming and multitasking. With an 80W SuperVOOC flash charge and a massive 7000mAh battery, you get days of power that charges in minutes. 【CAMERA – Vivid, Naturally Lit Portraits in Any Condition】:Capture stunning portraits day or night. With the industry’s widest 50MP front camera (100° FOV), fit more friends in every selfie. AI Flash Photography 2.0 uses a dual flash system for bright, clear shots in total darkness, while AI Portrait Glow can professionally relight any photo after it’s taken. Get creative with Seamless Camera Switch during recording and Dual-View Video to film with both cameras at once. 【AI SUPER TOOLS – Your Intelligent Travel and Life Assistant】:Break down barriers and organize your digital world with a built-in AI suite. Communicate anywhere with real-time AI Translate for conversations, photos, and even live calls. Automatically capture key points with AI Call Summary and VoiceScribe for meeting notes. Instantly save and recall anything on your screen into smart collections with AI Mind Space, and harness Google’s most advanced AI with deep Gemini integration and Circle to Search. 【CONNECTIVITY & PRIVACY – Seamless Sharing with Fortress Security】:Connect effortlessly across ecosystems while your data stays locked down. O+ Connect allows seamless file sharing, note syncing, and even connection with Apple Watch. Use Touch to Share for one-tap NFC transfers with OPPO and Apple devices. Your data is protected by the industry's most thorough anti-theft OPPO Lock and military-grade Private Computing Cloud (PCC), which uses end-to-end hardware encryption to keep cloud data "visible yet unusable" to anyone but you.
